question.prompt: A school library's collection increases from 5 ten-thousand volumes to 7.2 ten-thousand volumes over two years. Let the average annual growth rate be \(x\). Which equation can be set up?

solutions.explanation: With the same growth rate each year, the collection after two years is \(5(1+x)^2\), so the equation is \(5(1+x)^2=7.2\). B treats compound growth as simple growth.
solutions.title: Apply the annual growth factor twice
